scope: Compute core and standalone memory/control blocks; not full-transformer RTL or physical FPGA validation

switchboard.reference: independent NumPy INT64, explicit INT32 wrap

hbm_read_frontends.scope: HBM-clock-domain read frontends, behavioral AXI target, no PHY/CDC or FPGA timing validation

hbm_read_clock_crossings.scope: Digital CDC behavior only; no metastability, vendor PHY or physical timing claim

hbm_directed.scope: Directed digital HBM protocol and CDC checks; no physical timing or vendor PHY claim

reports.checks: X on unused lanes/seeds, result arithmetic, stalls and reset

real_decode_tiles.scope: Full 64x64 INT8 compute RTL; production-size synthetic operands, not model weights or a full token pipeline
real_decode_tiles.independent_oracle: NumPy INT64 matrix multiplication with explicit signed INT32 modular wrap
checks: every requested A/B and active C address
parallel rows, multiple waves and ragged output tiles
minimum/maximum signed INT8 and INT32 wrap
poison values on unused operand and partial-sum inputs
limitations: The 200 MHz simulation period does not establish FPGA timing closure.
HBM/DMA/CDC and vector/SFU integration are outside these arithmetic component tests.
These component timings do not establish end-to-end tokens/second.
